answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Accredited pattern cutter block record with pattern cutters endorsement, priced at 3-year training, 450 supervised cuttings, master review, annual re-assessment. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 10464 minutes per epoch, forever. The zenith is stamped by a stranger, the nebula is counted by a ledger, and the plume is filed by a clerk with no stake in it. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
